python3 - <<'EOF'
import redis, struct
r = redis.Redis(port=6379)

class R:
    def __init__(s, b): s.b=b; s.i=0
    def u8(s):
        v=s.b[s.i]; s.i+=1; return v
    def len(s):
        b=s.u8(); t=b>>6
        if t==0: return b&0x3f
        if t==1: return ((b&0x3f)<<8)|s.u8()
        if t==2:
            lo=b&0xff
            if lo==0x80: v=int.from_bytes(s.b[s.i:s.i+4],'big'); s.i+=4; return v
            if lo==0x81: v=int.from_bytes(s.b[s.i:s.i+8],'big'); s.i+=8; return v
            raise ValueError(f'bad 32/64 len byte {lo:#x} at {s.i-1}')
        raise ValueError(f'ENCVAL in length position {b:#x} at {s.i-1}')
    def rawstr(s):
        n=s.len(); v=s.b[s.i:s.i+n]; s.i+=n
        if len(v)!=n: raise ValueError('short string')
        return v
    def ms(s):  # rdbSaveMillisecondTime: 8 raw bytes
        v=s.b[s.i:s.i+8]; s.i+=8; return v
    def sid(s):
        v=s.b[s.i:s.i+16]; s.i+=16; return v
    def rest(s): return len(s.b)-s.i

stats = {'streams':0,'nack_zone_total':0,'idmp_nonzero':[],'groups':0,'consumers':0,'pel':0}
cur=0
while True:
    cur, keys = r.scan(cursor=cur, count=500, _type='stream')
    for k in keys:
        p = r.dump(k)
        assert p[0]==27, (k,p[0])
        body = p[:-8]
        rr = R(body); rr.u8()  # type
        nlp = rr.len()
        for _ in range(nlp):
            rr.rawstr(); rr.rawstr()
        for _ in range(8): rr.len()   # length,last,first,maxdel,entries_added
        ng = rr.len(); stats['groups'] += ng
        for _ in range(ng):
            rr.rawstr()               # group name
            rr.len(); rr.len()        # last id
            rr.len()                  # entries_read
            npel = rr.len(); stats['pel'] += npel
            for _ in range(npel):
                rr.sid(); rr.ms(); rr.len()
            nc = rr.len(); stats['consumers'] += nc
            for _ in range(nc):
                rr.rawstr(); rr.ms(); rr.ms()
                ncpel = rr.len()
                for _ in range(ncpel): rr.sid()
            nack = rr.len(); stats['nack_zone_total'] += nack
            for _ in range(nack): rr.sid()
        idmp_dur = rr.len(); idmp_max = rr.len()
        nprod = rr.len()
        entries = 0
        for _ in range(nprod):
            rr.rawstr()
            c = rr.len(); entries += c
            for _ in range(c):
                rr.rawstr(); rr.len(); rr.len()
        iids_added = rr.len(); iids_dup = rr.len()
        if entries or nprod or iids_added or iids_dup:
            stats['idmp_nonzero'].append((k, nprod, entries, iids_added, iids_dup))
        assert rr.rest()==0, (k, rr.rest(), 'leftover bytes')
        stats['streams'] += 1
    if cur==0: break
print(stats)
